message_content: Mom, I've already taken Xinxin to school. Are you coming home for lunch at noon?
Coach Zhao, thank you for this morning's guidance. I have recorded the training plan. I will start executing it next week.
Mr. Wong, thank you for signing the critical illness insurance policy today. I have completed the follow-up arrangements. Wishing you and your family good health and peace.
Manager Li, we plan to visit your bank early next month to consult about low-risk wealth management products. Is it convenient to make an appointment?
Weiming, take the kids to Kowloon Park at 1:30 p.m., and remember to bring water bottles and sun hats.
Shanshan, Happy New Year! Let's exchange insights from the Shenzhen sharing session on the first workday after the holiday. See you then!
Picked up little brother! They just arrived, and the kids were so happy holding up the pickup sign.
Ming, Shanshan and I are going to try out Huanbai Beauty Studio tonight. I might be home a bit late; please pick up the kids from school.
Xinxin, Xinxin and I have arrived at the main entrance. Where are you all?
Mingzai, I'll buy the soup ingredients tonight. Remember to pick up the kids from school.
Mrs. Li, regarding the medical insurance reimbursement documents, please take photos of the diagnosis certificate, expense list, and invoice and send them to me. I will help you check them.
Brother Hua, I've finished the urgent matters at hand. I'm planning to go out to see a client this afternoon. Reporting this for your approval.
Mr. Wang, see you at Kerry Plaza in Futian tomorrow at 3 p.m. Please bring your ID card and Hong Kong-Macau Travel Permit. Looking forward to meeting you.
Me: Mom, breakfast this morning was so warm and lovely, thank you, love you!
Me: Today is Xuanxuan's school sports meet, I'm going to cheer him on!
Mingzai: For next week when I'm at the meditation retreat, here are the kids' pickup and drop-off arrangements: Grandma picks up Zaizai, and you take Xinxin to her interest class, right?
Good morning! How did you sleep last night? Looking forward to today's mindful breakfast.
Morning! I made spinach egg rolls and soy milk, and the whole family ate together. I'm so happy!
Xuanxuan made the assist! The team is leading 2:1!
Ming, is everything okay at home? Xuanxuan and Xinxin are already asleep, and I have settled Grandma here too. You should get some rest as well.
Mingzai, I might be home late tonight. You all eat first, no need to wait for me.
Xinxin, I got up this morning and I'm still really worried about Feizai. I hope there will be good news today.
Dad, see you at 2 p.m. at Hongyun Café. I've got the materials ready. Good luck!
Mom, I'm going to pick up Xinxin now and will be home a bit later.
Xinxin, happy Labor Day! What are your plans today?
Ashan, I don't quite understand several trust calculation questions in the CFP tax chapter. Do you have time to explain them to me?
Shanshan, the morning meeting materials have been sent to your email. Please check.
Shanshan, I'm stuck in traffic and may be about ten minutes late. Please take a look at the morning meeting materials first.
Mom, Mingzai and I have arrived at the market. The shrimp are very fresh. Should we buy some pork too?
Mingzai, I bought honey and lemons. I'll make lemon honey water tonight.
Me: Mom, I'm about to leave work. I'll buy oranges and kiwifruit on the way home. What would you like for dinner?
Mingzai, I won’t be home for lunch; I’m going out to eat with Su Lishan. Remember to pick up the kids from school.
Kaixin, I was a bit unhappy with Dad at dim sum this morning, but after getting home and playing with the kids, I feel much better.
Jiaxin, you were so engaged in the second half of the practice! The leaf you embroidered is really exquisite!
Mingzai, good luck on your first day of trial work today! We'll wait for you to come home for dinner tonight.
Ming, remember to bring Xuanxuan and Xinxin's backpacks and water bottles, and be safe on the way.
Liu Qian, about those two high-net-worth clients, remember to communicate carefully. The permission to review their materials has been enabled. If you have any questions, come to me anytime.
Me: Mom, I just bought an Ashtanga monthly pass at the yoga center. From now on, I'll go on Tuesday and Thursday mornings!
Honey, I'll get on the draft revisions I mentioned at breakfast this morning. Remember to pick up Xinxin at 4:30 this afternoon.
Mom, I ran 18 kilometers this morning and I'm so happy! This afternoon Jiaxin and I are going to Causeway Bay. Do you need me to bring anything back?
Xiaowei, I sent you the photos from yesterday's 18-kilometer run. You ran really well!
Me: Just finished running 20 kilometers, went home and had breakfast, the family is so happy. What are you doing this weekend?
Mom prepared Hong Kong-style milk tea and pineapple buns with butter. I ran 5 kilometers in the morning, and the yoga class was great too!
Me: A Wen, I got a PB on this morning's run! Average pace 6:10 per km, so happy!
Just did some yoga stretching, my legs feel much better. Tomorrow I'm heading to Macau. Let's go for a run when I get back!
Mingzai, Xuanxuan and I are going out. Take Xinxin to the art studio and be careful on the way.
Me: Mingzai, don't forget the parent-teacher meeting tomorrow at 7 PM.
Brother Hua, I have drafted the client visit plan. Mrs. Chen and Mr. Li have been scheduled to meet next week. Please check the email for details.
Mingzai, I've finished checking Xuanxuan's summer homework. Two pages were missed, and I've already taught him to fill them in. Don't worry.
Mom: Son, is school going well? Remember to bring your watercolor pens!
[HSBC] Dear customer, there have been recent fund movements in your family joint account. It is recommended that you plan your finances. Reply for details or consultation.
Awen, I did a 4 km recovery run this morning and it felt great!

I've just reviewed the responsibility reorganization and found that the main cause of the new employees' complaints was a lack of perceived fairness in communication. Should we discuss it in the afternoon meeting?
Ming, are you coming home for lunch? I brought the sandwiches Mom made.
Honey, good luck with the exam! Love you.
A Ling, today I did Cantonese embroidery with Xuanxuan and Xinxin. The kids were so happy! Xinxin embroidered a small flower, and Xuanxuan drew a racing car. Super creative.
[Fengchao] Your package has arrived at the Fengchao locker in Whampoa Garden. Pickup code 1234. Please collect it promptly.
Mom, thanks for taking care of Xinxin this morning. I'm heading out now. I might be back late tonight, so don't wait for me for dinner.
Mom, good morning! Thank you for the breakfast you prepared this morning. It was delicious. Please also take care to rest and not work too hard.
The Cantonese embroidery piece Daughter's World Autumn is finally finished and hung on the wall. I'm so happy!
Xiaowei, don't take the class group thing to heart. Everyone's emotional; let's talk privately another day.
Good morning, I got up early today to run in the park. The weather is nice!

Xinxin, good morning! Today is the Double Ninth Festival. Our whole family is going to climb Victoria Peak. We are having breakfast now, and the atmosphere is so warm. Wishing you a happy holiday too!
Xinxin, I got the last pineapple bun after work today, and I'm in a great mood! Have you been busy lately?
Xiaowei, how is your PPT preparation going? Do you need me to take a look before the afternoon meeting?
Ah Ming, come back once you've bought the rice rolls; everyone is waiting.
Ming, we'll wait for you at the finish line tomorrow! Remember to bring the fuel card.
Mom, I bought broccoli and fruit. I'll be home soon.
Me: Xinxin, seeing your message makes me so happy! I'm so proud of you. Let's have lunch together to celebrate! Shall we meet at Men Wah Bing Teng?
Morning, Xinxin! I’m on the subway. Nice weather today!
Me: Mingzai, breakfast is almost ready, you can wake the children now.
Honey, I'm about to leave. See you at Fung Shing Restaurant tonight!
Mom, I’ve already taken Zixuan and Xinxin to school. Don’t worry.
Mom, I'm meeting friends this afternoon, so don't wait for me for dinner.
Xiaowei, what healthy ingredients did you buy? I'll cook with them tonight.
Mom, I'm coming to help in the kitchen. Should I wash the vegetables or chop them?
Mom, during my lunch break today I did a health summary. The eye care and diet adjustments worked well. I'll teach you when I get home tonight.
Today went so smoothly! Client Mrs. Chan signed the deal, and also gave me Hokkaido White Lover chocolate. I'll bring it home tonight to share with you.
Mr. Liang, I'll arrive at your office at 2:30 pm sharp.
OK, Room 1506, 15th floor. Just come up.
Your credit card ending in 1234 was charged HKD 30.00 at 19:35. Merchant: Hong Kong Cross-Harbour Minibus Co., Ltd.
Just found Weiming's college love letters during a big clean-up. Haha, I'm dying laughing! I'm calling to gossip with you.
The tangyuan are ready. Come back and eat them soon. Don't take what happened just now to heart; I know you're under a lot of pressure.
Sis, I'll cover the hotel costs for the trip to Japan. You just need to book the flights and plan the itinerary!
Wenhui, yesterday's gathering was so fun! On my card I wrote, 'May every tomorrow be brighter than today, happy birthday, love you forever!' I hope she likes it.
Weiming, I've just walked almost 10,000 steps and still haven't found Fatty.
Today, while looking at cars at the Toyota showroom on Gloucester Road, I unexpectedly ran into my high school classmate He Junjie! We chatted for quite a while. What a coincidence.

Hello, Mrs. He. I'm Yu Xiaowei from AIA. Just confirming our meeting at 3 p.m. the day after tomorrow (April 9) at the business café. I will explain the savings plan to you in detail then. Please let me know if there are any changes. Thank you!

Manager Li, today's discussion on corporate group insurance cooperation was very productive. I will have the reply on rate discounts and underwriting grace period compiled for you before next Tuesday.
Honey, my meditation retreat is over and I've got my phone back. Today I'm planning to do a long run — an 18-kilometer seaside run — and then I'll head home.
Tonight at home we had a double roast platter, blanched choy sum, garlic broccoli, and lotus root pork rib soup. Finally got some roast pork, so satisfying!

Regarding customer Mr. Li's accidental fall injury claim (policy number P20250425001), because the case was not reported within 24 hours, it does not comply with the policy terms, and payment cannot be made at this time. Please communicate with the customer to provide additional materials.
Dad, thank you for pouring the rice wine for me tonight. I'm really happy to share some good news with you: I'm about to be promoted!
Congratulations, daughter, you've made something of yourself. We fully support you.
I walked 5,000 steps today and feel quite tired.
Xiaowei, yesterday's party was great! I'm so glad Xuanxuan liked the sports water bottle so much. Let's go running together next time!
Done!
At 12:30 on July 5, 2025, you spent 58 yuan at the small bookshelf in Huangpu Fitness Center.
Mom, I just bought you a pair of pure gold earrings at Chow Sang Sang. Happy Women's Day! You're definitely going to love them.
Just got done talking with Brother Hua. The regional adjustment is still being discussed; he told me to stay steady and focus on delivering results.
Ms. Yu, the recommended prescription cat food and cat teaser wand have arrived; you can go to kapokku to buy them.
Today I did embroidery with my mother-in-law. She taught me a new stitch, and I was very happy.
Honey, this menu is full of ceremony — you really know how to make life stylish!
I had just told my son the story of the statues on the memorial archway, and he asked a lot of history questions. It was really interesting.
Uncle Liang recommended 'The Record of Picking Fragrance'.
I just finished tallying with He Meiling. The charity sale total is HK$28,500! I've sent you the photos; take a look.

Hello Xiaowei, this is Uncle Liang. The book recommended today, A Record of Gathering Fragrance, is really worth reading; we can discuss it together at the next book club. The next gathering is set for July 5 at 2 PM, still at the usual place. Looking forward to your sharing!
Arrived at Lady M, waiting for you by the window seat, the Victoria Harbour view is amazing!
Yuxin's mom: Yuxin won the Best Expression Encouragement Award today! So happy for her.
Mom wore a dark red coat. We talked about Xuanxuan's math and Xinxin's ballet, and she was not so nervous anymore.
Today I ran 4.6 km in Kowloon Tsai Park. I started at a pace of 7 minutes per km, then gradually increased to 6:30 per km.
Just finished an 18-kilometer seaside run! Here's a selfie for you, feeling good 😊

Xiaowei, your embroidery piece "Daughter's World: Autumn" is very exquisite, and the leaf veins are rendered with great vividness. I really appreciate it. I suggest you participate in the Hong Kong Traditional Crafts Exhibition. I look forward to your "Winter" creation.
Mom, we have a Christmas party next Friday, and the teacher said we have to bring gifts for the exchange!
After a month of work, my 'baby' is finally finished! I'm going to the teacher's place this afternoon.
Mr. Zhang, would next Wednesday afternoon be convenient for a face-to-face meeting?
Weiming is comparing prices; he has taken a liking to both the latex paint and the folding workbench. Does anyone have any opinions?

Today I brought the children to my mother-in-law's house. She looks great and can even bend down on her own—recovering so quickly. We had green radish, carrot, and pork bone soup, and my daughter's painting was praised too.
Confirm that the draft proposal will be completed within this week. Regarding the incentive and task allocation optimization we discussed today, I will organize it and send it to you.

Weiming, I just arrived at Mom's place. She missed a step and twisted her ankle, and it's already swollen. I contacted Dr. Zhou for guidance on icing it. Don't worry too much. Come straight to Golden Bridge Mansion in Kwun Tong after work. Mom and I will be waiting for you here.
I just had a big sleep, two and a half hours. I pulled the curtains tight and changed into pajamas, and slept really soundly.
Just now, Xuanxuan made a wish to travel to Japan and was overjoyed to receive the running shoes.
Jiaxin, have you arrived? I'm on the way, I'll get to Lady M around two.
I'm here, I'm here! I'm at the window seat, waiting for you!
Today I brought the kids hiking at Tai Lam Chung. They picked up a lot of beautiful fallen leaves and branches, which gave me perfect inspiration for my Cantonese embroidery piece "Winter"! So happy.
Xiaowei, Happy Dragon Boat Festival! Wishing you and your family health and peace!
Lishan, thank you! The whole family was just making zongzi. I'll send you a few photos. Let's have dim sum together after the holiday if you're free!

Hello, Teacher Li, I am Yu Xiaowei, Zhang Yuxin's mother. Today Yuxin won the Best Expression Encouragement Award at the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Children's Ballet Open Competition. Thank you very much for your careful guidance and encouragement all along!

[Order Confirmation] You have successfully placed an order for a custom pour-over coffee kettle (Japanese gooseneck kettle). Engraving content: one side engraved with "ZW", the other side engraved with "2010.05.20". Gift wrapping service selected. Estimated delivery date: 2025-12-23. Thank you for your purchase!
Xinxin was especially delighted to receive the Guangdong embroidery zodiac dog pendant and hung it on her schoolbag right away, unable to put it down!
Jiaxin, see you at Lady M tomorrow at 2 PM!

Su Lishan, I just read the overseas asset allocation case you shared. The combination of US stocks and QDII was quite inspiring. I have a client who wants to do a similar allocation but prefers a more conservative approach. What do you think?
[Bank Notification] Your credit card ending in 1234 was charged HK$520.00 at the children’s clothing section of Harbour City on January 16 at 15:30 (light pink ballet skirt).
Mom, sorry to trouble you to pick her up, thank you!

[OSIM] Dear Ms. Yu Xiaowei, your OSIM uAngel Pro massage chair has been scheduled for delivery on December 21, 2025 at 2:00 PM. Order number: OS20251221001. If you have any questions, please call 852-12345678.

Hi Lishan, I just talked with the new hire Li Ming, and he has some opinions about the task assignment. Would you be able to objectively evaluate the current work allocation process? If you have time this afternoon, shall we discuss it?
Xiaowei, the envelope says 'For the children to remember — Grandpa.' Inside are a few old HSBC 10-yuan and 100-yuan notes, to be sent to Sister Wenhui.

Mom, Fatty's test results are out. It's gastroenteritis caused by hairballs. The doctor says he needs to stay in the hospital for IV fluids and observation for a few days. I'm so worried now, anxious and heartbroken. I'll stay at the hospital with him and let you know when there's news.

[Didi Chuxing] You have successfully booked a ride. Driver Wang (YueB·12345) is heading to the pickup location: the main gate of Whampoa Garden. Destination: the 24-hour pet hospital at 101 Ma Tau Wai Road, Hung Hom. Estimated arrival in 3 minutes. Please stay safe.
He has decided to choose another company and thanked Yu Xiaowei for her efforts.
Darling, the signature xiaolongbao and scallion oil noodles we just had at Crystal Jade La Mian Xiao Long Bao were really good, very satisfying!
Mr. Chen, the raid we ran last time was so much fun. Let's discuss the details at our meeting tomorrow!
Mr. Wang, you were very interested in Plan B discussed today and said you'd give specific details within a week. I'm ready to cooperate at any time.
I'm almost at the fountain. Are you there yet?
Teacher Yu, today's Cantonese embroidery class was very rewarding for us. Looking forward to the next activity!

Ms. Wu looked at the Peony Painting, said the stamen stitches were tight and the leaf veins had good depth, but the color at the bottom of the leaves was a bit dark. She suggested touching it up with light ochre. I noted it down and will come back early next month to learn.
Everyone did great on the bike ride today. At the meeting, we all praised the children's perseverance and performance.
I've picked up Xuanxuan and Xinxin. We're walking to Fung Shing Restaurant now. See you in a bit!
Miss Yu, the navel oranges you ordered this morning have arrived. Please come to pick them up this evening. Thank you!
Back home, about to have some tea.
Yuxin is drawing the Venice Canal at the museum's cultural and creative shop, and she's doing a good job.
We're home, Mom has already made soup.
Checkout is done, luggage has been stored, ready to go.
Zixuan was playing the F4 racing simulator in the simulation driving area of the Grand Prix Museum, super excited! I recorded the whole thing and will send it to you later.
Just walked through Love Lane, it feels so romantic! Both sides are full of colorful houses, great for a walk.
Su Lishan, let's meet on time at 4:30 p.m. at the Brew Cellar. Don't be late!
I'm home. Mom is stir-frying dishes. I've put the red wine away. I'll help her set the table in a bit.
I also bought a bottle of Carménère. Let's come to the wine tasting regularly from now on!
Tonight I'm going to my parents' house for dinner. I deliberately brought a bottle of red wine and cookies, hoping to ease the tension.
Mom and Dad, I'll be right there. I brought Chilean Carménère red wine and Jenny Bakery cookies, picked out at last night's workshop. They taste great — please try them.
Mom, I'll pick up some oranges on the way and be home soon.
Xiaowei, your Cantonese embroidery for the Year of the Tiger is amazing! Bring your work to my house next week and I'll give you my comments in person.
Okay, Teacher Wu, see you next week.
Test drive is booked. See you tomorrow.
Just finished an 18 km run, done stretching, now taking a taxi back.
The vase broke; what matters is checking that the child is fine.
Got it, see you tomorrow!

Happy New Year! Thank you for your continued support and trust. Wishing you a flourishing career and family happiness in the new year! I look forward to our continuing to work hand in hand. Sincerely, Yu Xiaowei.
Weiwei, we're about to sit down for the meal. Bring the kids over. The ancestor worship ceremony is scheduled for 4:30 p.m., don't forget.

Zhiyuan, I was so happy to meet you at Wong Tai Sin Temple today! Let's arrange a time to have yum cha. How about the seventh day of the Lunar New Year? I've booked a table at Tao Heung in Mong Kok. See you at ten?
Got it, see you tomorrow!
Happy New Year! Our whole family has set off to Wong Tai Sin Temple. We just left at 8 a.m. Wishing us all good luck!
The black moss and dried oysters are ready. Once you've prepared the ingredients, come out.
Xiaowei, remember to buy sugar-free steamed buns for Dad.
Xiaowei, happy New Year! Wishing you and your family happiness and all the best! Did you have a good New Year's Eve dinner?

Lishan, happy New Year! Wishing you all the best! We had the New Year's Eve dinner at home; my parents made many dishes. We just finished watching the Spring Festival Gala comedy sketches and were really happy. How about your family?
Did flower arranging with Dad and my husband; put the daffodils next to the TV cabinet and the peach blossoms in the corner of the balcony.
Mother-in-law is already asleep
My mother-in-law's lower back muscles are tight and she has applied a medicated patch. I'll stay overnight to look after her and let him take care of the children.
Just helped my mother-in-law wash up and settle onto the sofa to rest. I had wanted to review my CFP notes, but I was too sleepy, my eyelids were drooping, so I had to give up. 😩
[Fresh Delivery] The vegetables you ordered have been delivered to the entrance of Jinqiao Mansion on Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong. Please pick them up in time.
Mother-in-law is stable this morning and has already been fed congee. Don't worry. How about we do the handover after work tonight, around 7:30?
Xiaowei, I'm going to Mom's house now to help her with her rehabilitation exercises. I already took the kids to school this morning, so don't worry.

Weiming, I've written down the medication and care instructions for you, and the ice pack and medicated oil are on the kitchen counter. I have an appointment this afternoon, so please take care of Mom today.
Prepared the quilt and pillows; reminded to monitor the ankle for swelling.
Thank you for coming to hand over. My mother-in-law is in good spirits. Go home and rest early; I'll keep watch tonight.
Xiaowei, don't worry too much about your mother-in-law. She will definitely get better. Go to work with peace of mind; I'll take care of things at home.
Mom, I just applied a new medicated patch for you. Does it feel comfortable? Tell me if you feel any discomfort.
Today I made congee for my mother-in-law with fish slices and greens, and stir-fried choy sum, which is suitable for her recovery.
My mother-in-law sprained her ankle today. She just fell asleep and the pain has eased. Don't worry.
Much better. I've applied the medicine on time, don't worry.
After my mother-in-law finished the fish slice porridge and choy sum, her ankle was not swollen, and she had been wiped down and changed into her pajamas.
At noon I made a lean pork and hairy gourd soup, ate with my mother, and after she took her medicine she went to sleep.
The papaya and snow fungus dessert is heated up. Remember to drink it.
I took my mother-in-law to buy a cane and bandages, totaling 1,150 Hong Kong dollars, and also bought soothing cream at the pharmacy across the street.
Mom, I'm downstairs. Come down.
I'm in the living room drawing with Yuxin, while the kids and Mom are reading magazines.
Just ate wonton noodles, beef brisket rice, and iced lemon tea at New Shanghai Kitchen. The kids fell asleep in the car; they were worn out.
Mrs. He, I'm at the fruit shop downstairs. I'll be at your place shortly. Thank you for helping take care of my mother-in-law during the day!
My mother-in-law's follow-up appointment went well today, and her knee has recovered nicely. What a relief! I'll take her to Dexing Teahouse for yum cha to celebrate.
Appointment booked for next Wednesday (April 30) at 3 p.m. at Grace Physiotherapy in Kwun Tong, accompanied by Weiming. Please be on time.

Hello, Mrs. He! Today I bought a fruit basket at the fruit shop, and I'd like to give it to you to thank you for always taking care of my mother-in-law. I'll bring it over this evening. Is that convenient?
Remember to buy the chocolate cookies our daughter loves after work.
OK
I just told Mingzai about my new decision, and he said he fully supports my further studies. It feels great!
In the afternoon, she ordered kids' milk for the children at Starbucks, and they loved it!
Mom, I'm wearing that dark blue skirt suit to the office today because of the promotion meeting.
Tonight my mother, my husband, and I made steamed sea bass and broccoli, and everyone enjoyed the meal! After dinner, I'm going to the study to study the new CFP course.
This approach is very clear, and I feel more confident. If he delays his reply, what should I do?
I've arrived at Kowloon City Market, waiting for you at the usual spot on the 3rd floor!
Peiwen, don’t forget to bring your running shoes and sportswear. The hotel in Macau has a coastal walkway. Looking forward to a morning run together!
Today I saw an electric car advertisement in Sham Shui Po. Our old car has a lot of problems. Let's go check out a car dealership this weekend?
Took the children to Kowloon City Plaza. First, we went to Fotomax to develop photos, then to Rixin Stationery Store to buy cork boards.
This morning I weighed 55.7 kg, a bit lighter than last time.
Just weighed myself; I'm a bit lighter than yesterday. Now I have motivation to start the diet plan tomorrow.
Just finished 3 sets of planks and 2 sets of leg raises—I'm exhausted.
Just picked up the high-speed rail ticket for train G6512, departing at 08:00, and brought some biscuits to eat on the way.
Dr. Wang, the red rash on my left arm is still slightly raised this morning, but it seems to have become smoother. Do I need to continue applying the medication?
Tomorrow at 3 p.m., let's meet at % Arabica, I heard it's amazing!
The whole family had dinner together tonight. I video-called my mother-in-law, and she praised the food for being delicious.
Please send me on WeChat the photo of the contract terms we discussed on the phone just now.
Weiming, I want to talk to you when you get home tonight. I've been under a lot of pressure lately.

My mother-in-law just slipped while mopping the floor at home. I brought her to United Christian Hospital to see orthopedics. The initial diagnosis is a ligament tear, and she needs to rest and recover.

Manager Liang, today the new team member Liu Qian joined smoothly. I completed her orientation and introduced her to the team, and she is now familiarizing herself with the system. The management pressure after team expansion is indeed not small. I will strengthen mentoring and coordination going forward to ensure work progresses in an orderly manner.
The strawberries are very fresh, the cherries are large, and I also bought dried shredded squid and crispy egg pastry.
You paid HKD 5,800 to Hong Kong Financial Management Institute at 20:45, balance HKD 72,350.00

Dad, Mom, Ming, Xuanxuan, and Xinxin: I got promoted! Today it was officially announced that I have been promoted to deputy manager. How about we go to Chongfa Chaozhou Restaurant tonight to celebrate?
I checked my travel permit and phone, and I have them both. Could you help me double-check that the gift box is okay?
Mom, today I went to the community center to ask about the family community insurance plan. To fill out the form, we need our ID copies and proof of income. Could you look for them when you get home?
Today, while having dessert at Jia Jia Sweet Soup Shop, we discussed Xuanxuan's birthday party and decided to have it at the McDonald's in Whampoa New Town. How about next Saturday?
The kids' soccer class starts at 8:30. I'll leave at 7:45 to drop them off. You can go straight to the medical check-up, and don't forget to bring some candy.
This morning's breathing exercises relaxed my shoulders and neck a lot, and I felt energetic all day.
Dad was adjusting his collar; I told him to relax and not be nervous.
[Consumption Notice] You spent $380 on dried fish maw at the dried goods store in Kowloon City. Payment completed.
At Gangrong, I bought salted duck eggs and dried bamboo leaves to prepare for making zongzi for the Dragon Boat Festival.
Mom, does your back still hurt?
It's okay, it doesn't hurt anymore, don't worry.
Xiaowei, remember to buy some fruit after work. There's none at home.
Okay, I'll buy cherries and apples on my way back.
I've finished the CFP questions. Come to the study and let's measure the storage room.

Shanshan, I just thought about it, and your suggestion is really clever. Having him report his scattered progress himself lets him realize the problem without making me seem too strict. At this afternoon's meeting, I plan to have him report first. Thank you!
Mom, I'm taking the kids to the Cultural Center to see a ballet tonight. We'll eat out afterward, so you don't need to cook dinner.
Mom, I'll leave home at 4 p.m. Take the kids and wait for me at Exit E of Tsim Sha Tsui MTR station, and we'll go see the ballet together.

Weiming, remember to check out the car this weekend. I've already looked up the environmental subsidy information and sent it to you for reference. Mom suggested we go for dim sum after seeing the car. What do you think?
[Bank Alert] Your credit card ending in 1234 was charged 8.50 yuan at the Convention Plaza convenience store on 2025-08-07 at 12:20. Balance: 3456.78 yuan.
The dumplings my daughter wrapped are crooked, but the filling didn't leak out. Amazing!
Honey, Dad asked me this morning about the hiking gear, and I said everything is ready.
I talked with Dad today. He's in a much better mood. I told him not to blame himself; health is the most important thing. I also mentioned that we can support him if needed.
Regarding He Jiaming's exercise plan, I think we can have him take part in the preparations for the appreciation event.
Yuxin drew a flying tiger today — so imaginative! It made me think of embroidering a Year of the Tiger piece!
Video call at 8:30 tonight; bring the price tag and the payment QR code.
Thank you for sharing the 16:8 fasting method. I've decided to try it after I get back from the Macau trip!
Hi Junwei, the client proposal is urgent. Please provide the Shenzhen market rules data as soon as possible. Can you get it to me before the end of today? Thanks!
Just now I accidentally played the music too loudly, and the neighbor came knocking. So embarrassing.
Thank you for your card! The wishes for your mother-in-law's recovery and the cat coming home are so heartwarming.

message_content: Manager Wang was poached by Zhou Minyi — my sister-in-law just told me. I'm shaking with anger.
I still can't sleep; my mind is full of Minyi.

Xiaowei, after dinner I thought it over. It is good that Weiming is changing careers, but you two should first focus on the present. I have some deposit certificates here; I will bring them to you tomorrow. Do not be too frugal.
[XX Bank] Your account ending in 1234 transferred HKD 5,000 to the family joint savings account at 18:40 on 06-30. Current balance XXXX.
So happy having tea today. You're all grown up now. No matter how busy work gets, take good care of yourself.
Su Lishan, for the He Junwen training plan we just discussed, you'll be responsible for the daily workflow, and I'll handle the weekly tests and business coaching. Shall we start tomorrow?
I'll wait for you at 3 p.m. at the Pacific Coffee on Prince Edward Road West, please.
Every Thursday evening from 8 to 9 p.m. is Family Documentary Night. The whole family must attend; no absences allowed.
Sorry, Thursday evening is our regular family documentary night, so I can't attend the gathering.
I'm watching "Hong Kong Handicrafts" at Tai Wan Shan Swimming Pool. There's a beautiful embroidery pattern in it. I'll take a photo and show you!

Mr. Liang, the deal in Shenzhen was signed successfully! The client contract has been signed, for 800,000 yuan, and payment is expected next week. The contract documents have been organized and will be submitted after returning to Hong Kong.
Honey, Mom accidentally sprained her back this afternoon, so I need to take care of her for a while. I'll go home and make dinner; just come straight home after work.
Mom, I signed up for an online Japanese course. Classes are on Monday and Wednesday evenings. Could you help watch the kids on those two nights?
No problem, go to your class without worry, I'll keep an eye on things for you.
Mr. Zhang has been assigned to you. Please contact and follow up promptly.
Done! 😊

Honey, we've arrived at the Sheraton Guangzhou Hotel. The room on the 35th floor has a great view. This afternoon I'm taking Yuxin to the Guangzhou Opera House for a ballet competition. She's a little nervous.
Weiming, I'm so nervous about tomorrow's training, but also excited. I've prepared for a long time, but I'm still afraid I won't deliver it well.

Director Liang, I have just completed the signing and filing of client Chen Meiling's insurance policy. The electronic file has been organized and the system updated. The signing summary has been sent to your email. Please check.

Dear Mr. Wang, the meeting this afternoon was very pleasant. Thank you for your recognition of the 'Global Guardian' plan and for saying it fits your team's needs. I look forward to your reply within a week after you discuss it with your partners. The electronic materials have been sent via WhatsApp; please check. If you have any questions, feel free to contact me.
Xiaowei, I'd like to recommend an international online Cantonese embroidery community. Many enthusiasts share works and techniques there. Here's the link: https://t.me/yuexiucommunity
